utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I’d like to know the timing and where folks should drop things off first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great — we’re starting Saturday morning at the community shed, and folks can drop off repairs there first. If you want, I can also swing by and help sort the first batch.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would help a lot — what time Saturday morning should I plan on, and is the shed easy to access for unloading?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive, and do you need me to adjust pickup?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Faye. I’m still waiting on the final time, but if you can keep pickup flexible, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely—I’ll keep pickup flexible and wait for the final time. Just send it over when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure thing — what’s the repair drive needing help with?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still piecing it together from the neighborhood chatter, but I think they need hands, tools, and maybe a few supplies.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I can probably help with tools or supplies. Just point me to whatever’s needed most.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what time should I bring the tools?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Could you bring them by 10? That’ll give us plenty of time to get everything set up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, I’ll bring them by 10.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help, Dane—what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what’s left on the list, and where do you need me?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No worries, Dane. We still need someone to sort the tools and check the porch light.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what’s needed for the repair drive, just so I get the details right before I help?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re mostly short on tape, screws, and a few basic tools—nothing too fancy. If you can bring any of those, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — tape, screws, and a few basic tools. I’ll see what I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m happy to help, just remind me what needs fixing again?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sure thing—mostly the broken fence, a leaky faucet at the hall, and a few loose porch steps. I’m putting together a quick list now, and I’ll send it your way.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Quinn—send the list over and I’ll take a look. I’ll do my best not to forget this time.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs to be done?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — we still need a few volunteers to sort donated materials, a couple people to manage sign-ins, and someone to keep the supply list updated.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can take the supply list and help sort materials too. If you want, I can also cover a sign-in shift.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t seen the repair drive setup yet, but I can keep an eye out and let you know where it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Opal. If you spot it, can you tell me the time and exact place?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll note the time and exact spot as soon as I find it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any fresh updates yet, but I’m heading out on errands later and can ask around about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, that’d be great—ask around when you’re out, and I’ll keep checking in too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll ask around while I’m out and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Right, I meant to check on that—did anything change?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Did anything change, or is it still the same as before?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think it’s probably still the same—I haven’t checked yet. Sorry, I get a little behind on these things.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Sam. Let’s keep it simple: please help sort the donated items and set them by the garage tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You got it — I’ll sort the donated items and set them by the garage tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—let’s keep it simple and stick to a clear plan for the repair drive. What’s the first thing you want me to help with?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Let’s confirm who’s bringing the supplies and where we’re meeting first. I’d rather sort the logistics now than scramble later.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That makes sense—let’s lock down the supplies and meeting spot first. I’m ready to note who’s bringing what and where we should meet.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I can swing by the repair drive after my errands and see what still needs helping with.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just to confirm — you’ll check what still needs help after your errands, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, I’ll check in after my errands and see what still needs help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re short on tape, screws, and a couple flashlights — if you can grab those, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can pick those up. I’ll grab tape, screws, and a couple flashlights.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo — I’m glad you’re here. I’m getting the repair drive organized now, and I’d love your help with the next steps.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — tell me what needs doing next, and I’ll help.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — first I’m making the repair list and matching people to jobs. If you can help me check who needs what, we’ll be in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive, Mara. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Sam — could you bring a drill, a tape measure, and a few screwdrivers? If you can, please help sort the donated tools when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring a drill, a tape measure, and some screwdrivers, and I’ll help sort the donated tools when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’ve been telling everyone about it—want me to send you the details for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, please—send me the details. I’d like to take a look.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll send them over right now, and if you want, I can also point out what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping an eye on where everything is going for the repair drive, Nell. If you need a drop-off spot or want me to check a location, just tell me.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Opal — could you check which drop-off spot is closest to Maple Street? I’m still piecing together the details from around the block.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll check that for you and figure out the closest drop-off spot to Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—thanks for the reminder. I’ll take a look and see what I can bring by.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks Oren — I’ll keep the repair drive in mind and let folks know you’re checking what you can bring by.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good — I’ll swing by once I’ve checked the garage and see what’s usable. If I find anything, I’ll bring it over.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help spread the word about the repair drive—who still needs to hear about it?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think a few folks on the block still haven’t heard—maybe Mrs. Patel and the guy in 3B. I’ve been a bit scattered, so I might be missing someone.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can check with Mrs. Patel and 3B, and I’ll mention it to a few others too. If you remember anyone else later, just send me their names.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a pretty good turnout so far—folks have been dropping off tools and a few supplies already.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’s great to hear. I can bring by a few extra tools later if you still need them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That would be wonderful, Gus—extra tools are always welcome. If you come by later, I’ll make sure they get added to the pile.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks for asking—before I say yes, could you share the repair drive details and what you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — it’s this Saturday at 10 a.m. at the community hall, and we’re fixing up bikes, lamps, and small furniture. If you can, just bring your toolbox and a few hours to help.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds good — I can help this Saturday. I’ll bring my toolbox and plan to stay a few hours.
